svg.title: Numerical oscillations and failure
svg.desc: At5 minute steps Euler oscillates toward8 mg despite a monotone exact solution. At9 minute steps the error grows and the mass becomes negative. These are numerical artifacts.
svg.title: Numerical oscillations and failure
